2607.16165.title: An Exam for Active Observers
2607.16165.paper_summary: Human vision is a closed loop: gaze is continuously redirected by intermediate hypotheses rather than a single snapshot. Decades of psychophysics and cognitive science have argued that this active observation is essential for a wide range of tasks. Whether today's multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exercise active observation is an empirical question that current vision-language benchmarks do not answer. We introduce ActiveVision, a benchmark that makes active observation measurable for MLLMs, comprising 17 tasks across 3 categories. Tasks are designed to force repeated visual perception rather than a single static description. Frontier MLLMs collapse on ActiveVision: the highest-scoring model we evaluate, GPT-5.5 at the highest exposed reasoning-effort tier, solves only 10.6% of items and scores zero on 11 of the 17 tasks, and even Claude Fable 5, despite topping most reasoning and coding leaderboards, solves just 3.5%, far behind three human participants who average 96.1%. Furthermore, much of the gap persists even when models write and run their own vision code: such code is unreliable on realistic imagery, and catching its failures itself requires the active perception the models lack. Together, these results indicate that current MLLMs lack robust active visual observation, motivating architectures and training objectives that close the perception-reasoning loop.
2607.16165.paper_summary_zh: 人類的視覺是一個閉環：目光不斷地被中介假設重新導向，而不是僅僅依賴單一的快照。幾十年的心理物理學和認知科學已經論證，這種主動觀察對於廣泛的任務至關重要。當今的多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）是否進行主動觀察是一個實證問題，而當前的視覺-語言基準並未回答這個問題。我們引入了ActiveVision，這是一個使主動觀察對MLLMs可測量的基準，包含3個類別中的17個任務。這些任務的設計旨在強迫重複的視覺感知，而不是單一的靜態描述。前沿的MLLMs在ActiveVision上崩潰：我們評估的得分最高的模型，GPT-5.5在最高的推理努力層級中，只解決了10.6%的項目，並且在17個任務中有11個得分為零，即使是Claude Fable 5，儘管在大多數推理和編碼排行榜中名列前茅，僅解決了3.5%，遠遠落後於三位參與者的平均得分96.1%。此外，即使模型編寫並運行自己的視覺代碼，這種差距仍然存在：這樣的代碼在現實圖像上不可靠，捕捉其失敗本身需要模型所缺乏的主動感知。總的來說，這些結果表明當前的MLLMs缺乏穩健的主動視覺觀察，這促使架構和訓練目標的改進，以縮短感知-推理的閉環。
